import sys, pathlib, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
from IPython import get_ipython
get_ipython().ast_node_interactivity = "last_expr"  # Quarto defaults to 'all', which would render every chained call
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("../scripts").resolve()))
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display
import awareness_analytics as aa
import awareness_plots as ap

D = aa.load_data("../data")
ph, tr, people = D["phishing"], D["training"], D["people"]
events = D["program_events"]
monthly = aa.monthly_rates(ph)
kpis = aa.quarter_kpis(ph, tr)
pre_m, post_m = aa.PRE_MONTHS, aa.POST_MONTHS
pre_last3 = pd.period_range("2025-12", "2026-02", freq="M")
post_last3 = pd.period_range("2026-07", "2026-09", freq="M")

def window_rate(col, months):
    d = ph[(ph["delivered"] == 1) & ph["month"].isin(months)]
    return d[col].mean()

click_pre3, click_post3 = window_rate("clicked", pre_last3), window_rate("clicked", post_last3)
report_pre3, report_post3 = window_rate("reported", pre_last3), window_rate("reported", post_last3)
pct = aa.pct

import json, uuid
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.offline import get_plotlyjs_version

_PLOTLY_JS_DONE = False
_PLOTLY_CONFIG = {"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False, "modeBarButtonsToRemove": ["lasso2d", "select2d"]}


def show(fig):
    """
    Emit one figure as a div plus a script that draws it AFTER the page has loaded.
    Quarto dashboards keep the page hidden while it initialises; if plotly.js draws
    during that window it measures legend text as zero-width and caches the value,
    so horizontal legend entries pile up on top of each other. Deferring the draw to
    the window 'load' event avoids that.
    """
    global _PLOTLY_JS_DONE
    head = "" if _PLOTLY_JS_DONE else f'<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-{get_plotlyjs_version()}.min.js"></script>'
    _PLOTLY_JS_DONE = True
    fid = f"fig-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}"
    spec = pio.to_json(fig, validate=False)
    html = (f'{head}<div id="{fid}" class="plotly-graph-div" style="height:100%; width:100%;"></div>'
            f'<script type="text/javascript">(function(){{var spec={spec};var cfg={json.dumps(_PLOTLY_CONFIG)};'
            f'function draw(){{window.requestAnimationFrame(function(){{Plotly.newPlot("{fid}",spec.data,spec.layout,cfg);}});}}'
            f'if(document.readyState==="complete"){{draw();}}else{{window.addEventListener("load",draw);}}}})();</script>')
    display(HTML(html))


def table_html(df, fmt=None, index=False):
    sty = df.style.hide(axis="index") if not index else df.style
    if fmt:
        sty = sty.format(fmt, na_rep="n<10")
    return HTML(sty.set_table_attributes('class="table table-sm table-striped"').to_html())
